description: This file is a runtime module for a plugin system, specifically for the 'matrix' plugin in the 'openclaw' project. It manages dynamic imports, resolves plugin SDK paths, and exports functions related to cryptographic runtime and verification handling.

methods.name: readPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses the package.json file from a given directory.

methods.name: findOpenClawPackageRoot
methods.description: Locates the root directory of the 'openclaw' package by traversing parent directories.

methods.name: resolveExistingFile
methods.description: Resolves the first existing file with specified extensions from a base path.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkAliasMap
methods.description: Builds a map of module aliases for the plugin SDK based on the package.json and directory structure.

methods.name: resolveBundledPluginRuntimeModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the plugin runtime module, searching local and package directories.
